# NFL.com

> The official digital hub of the National Football League, providing comprehensive coverage of live games, schedules, scores, standings, news, and multimedia content.

NFL.com serves as the authoritative source for NFL fans with real-time game information, streaming capabilities through NFL Network and NFL Channel, and extensive coverage of the regular season, playoffs, and Pro Bowl Games. The platform integrates live-streaming services, video highlights, and breaking news across all 32 teams and major events.

## Key Topics

- NFL
- Super Bowl

- NFL Network
- NFL+ Streaming

- Pro Bowl Games
- Breaking News

## Live Games & Streaming

- [NFL Network Home](https://www.nfl.com/network): NFL Network streaming hub featuring live games, shows and international coverage
- [NFL Channel | Always on. Always football.](https://www.nfl.com/watch/nfl-channel-live): 24/7 free NFL Channel with live games, replays and original programming
- [NFL Football Highlights, Clips & Analysis](https://www.nfl.com/videos): Video hub for game highlights, player clips and NFL event coverage

## Schedules & Scores

- [NFL.com | Official Site of the National Football League](https://www.nfl.com): Official NFL homepage with news, scores, schedules, stats and highlights
- [Live NFL Scores 2025](https://www.nfl.com/scores): Official NFL scoreboard with live scoring and real-time game highlights
- [2025 NFL Schedule](https://www.nfl.com/schedules): 2025 NFL game schedule with weekly matchups and playoff information
- [2025 NFL Schedule by Team](https://www.nfl.com/schedules/2025/by-team): Team-by-team 2025 NFL schedule with prime-time games and flexible scheduling

## Playoffs & Championships

- [2025 NFL Playoff Picture](https://www.nfl.com/standings/playoff-picture): 2025 NFL playoff picture with team standings and playoff race updates
- [NFL Official 2026 Playoff Bracket](https://www.nfl.com/playoffs/bracket): Official NFL playoff bracket with AFC/NFC matchups and Super Bowl path
- [NFL Pro Bowl Games Home](https://www.nfl.com/pro-bowl-games): Pro Bowl Games coverage with rosters, voting and all-star competition

## News & Coverage

- [NFL News | Latest NFL Football News](https://www.nfl.com/news): Latest NFL news covering trades, signings, draft analysis and roster moves
